original_ai_output.title_zh: 超过5.5万名苏丹难民涌入乍得，联合国呼吁提供资金
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国难民署表示，今年以来已有超过5.5万名苏丹难民逃往邻国乍得，仅过去一周经乍得阿德雷和蒂内边境地区入境的人数就升至每天400人，约为此前日均水平的20倍。联合国警告称，若资金不能大幅增加，这场人道主义危机将进一步恶化。苏丹自2023年4月爆发内战以来，已有超过1100万人流离失所。

location.site: 阿德雷和蒂内边境地区
location.raw_text: Chad's border areas of Adre and Tine

key_facts.fact: 今年以来超过5.5万名苏丹难民逃往乍得
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: More than 55,000 Sudanese refugees have fled to neighbouring Chad this year

key_facts.fact: 经乍得阿德雷和蒂内边境入境人数升至每天400人，约为此前日均的20倍
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The number of refugees entering via Chad's border areas of Adre and Tine has risen to 400 people a day, about 20 times the daily rate of previous months

key_facts.fact: 联合国警告若资金不显著增加，人道主义危机将进一步恶化
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: compounding a humanitarian crisis that will only deteriorate further unless there is a significant increase in funding, the United Nations has warned

key_facts.fact: 苏丹自2023年4月内战以来超过1100万人流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sudan has been engulfed in a civil war since April 2023 ... in excess of 11 million Sudanese people have been displaced
